answer_1.quote: Our method adopts a generative reasoning paradigm in which the judge model not only selects the best response but also engages in detailed reasoning over multiple candidate responses prior to making a decision.
answer_1.outputs: The paper focuses on generating reasoned judgments and selecting the best response among candidates in multimodal settings, particularly for open-ended visual questions and inference-time scaling of MLLMs.

answer_2.quote: We re-formulate the samples into MC questions with 2 candidate responses, and exact match is used to identify whether the judgement is correct.

answer_3.quote: Using LLMs as judges allows for more interpretable and diverse evaluation processes. These models not only select the best response but also provide reasoning behind their decisions, offering greater transparency and robustness in evaluation.
